purpose: N5 native credential Preview, legacy per-model quota, AG protection and explicit group release contract. This document records source semantics, not implemented frontend readiness.
evidence_boundary: Public repository source and synthetic tests inspected only. No test execution, business request, credential/database access or frontend changes. No MGMT development.

release.group_validation: Backend valid_group requires string, length 1..200, every character ord >=32, and group_for(group) == group. Known groups include claude-gpt-shared and gemini-shared, but valid other canonical groups are supported. Preserve real response keys; do not hard-code a two-group allowlist or copy an unknown catalog into the client.
release.server_semantics: After filename validation and credential existence check, AG + valid_group is required. Unsupported GCLI/invalid group returns 400; invalid persisted quota state returns 409 without clearing restrictions. Server does not require a frontend successful-response ticket. No force parameter or new release endpoint.

response.model_cooldowns: map of model IDs to Unix-second deadlines
response.quota_groups: map of group to {cooldownUntil:number}; this projection does NOT supply blockedUnknown/restricted booleans

release.mutation: quota_release changes an existing group's state to manual_override and increments its revision. It preserves other group fields/states and model_cooldowns. Missing prior group can return success with no state change. Release does not replenish remaining quota, prove upstream recovery or remove timed cooldown.
release.ui_policy: Only show/enable explicit release for the current owner and target after a successful current quota response, with blockedUnknown && !invalid && source === 'response'. This is the legacy page policy, NOT a server-enforced ticket. Failure, cache-only protection, malformed/conflicting state, stale owner or GCLI cannot enable release.
release.success_display: Validate semantic success before showing release success in the new adapter. State that abnormal blocking was released but timed cooldown remains. Refresh current-owner evidence; do not mark unrelated groups or all cooldowns clear. Legacy click handler checks HTTP success; that is not evidence that arbitrary HTTP-200 bodies are valid.
release.proposed_adapter_boundary: Prefer a new independent release adapter module with captured scope + validation identity fences, avoiding credentials/api.ts churn and Page/secret-error task conflicts. This is planning, not a new endpoint or delivered adapter.

preview.support: GCLI only; AG returns 400 before credential/upstream operations. Filename must end .json; missing credential 404; missing required access/project data 400.
preview.independent_outcomes: Binding 200/201 or already-existing 409 yields endpoint HTTP 200 success true and preview true. Local storage return === true yields applied; false yields failed. Already-existing branch omits setting_id/binding_id. Remote success is independent of local state_update; absent evidence is unknown, never assumed persisted.
preview.failures: Upstream setting/binding errors carry success false, preview false, message/error and step create_setting/create_binding. A thrown storage exception produces 500. Do not expose raw upstream error payloads as safe UI messages.
preview.capability: geminicli.preview.state_update advertises the response contract only in GCLI; do not invent AG support. Legacy batch Preview repeats the same one-file endpoint, not a separate batch endpoint.

legacy_model_quota.semantics: This legacy manual quota operation is separate from summary/window cards. AG calls antigravity_manual.quota(filename,sync=True), so it may synchronize protection state. Success and state-update evidence are separate; HTTP 200 alone is not success. Do not automatically run it or release protection because a countdown expires.

query.model: actual model testModel value, query-encoded once

test.trigger: explicit user action, captured owner and filename

model_fields.raw_model_key: Preserve the actual response model identifier.
model_fields.remaining: Finite valid fraction 0..1 when provided; missing/malformed/unknown stays unknown, never zero. Main native meter is remaining (1 = 100% available), per FULL_PARITY_REQUIREMENTS, although old JS used a used-percent bar.
model_fields.resetTime: formatted display string or N/A; not a Unix-second deadline
model_fields.resetTimeRaw: raw timestamp string or empty string; validate before countdown
model_fields.rolling168h: backend-observed rolling-week evidence; display recovery unknown and do not render it as a reliable countdown
model_fields.testModel: actual model ID for explicit test
model_fields.visible: visible false hides the card; omitted is not false

legacy_model_quota.protection_fields: quota_group_states, quota_groups, quota_state_invalid and model_cooldowns are AG evidence, independent of numeric remaining. Union actual response group keys with known groups, preserving unknown valid canonical groups.
legacy_model_quota.state_projection: Full quota summary projection may expose blockedUnknown/restricted/cooldownUntil. Release public_state projection only has cooldownUntil per group. Do not fabricate missing booleans or convert missing evidence into unrestricted.
legacy_model_quota.invalid_evidence: Treat invalid state, malformed state/maps/deadlines and conflicting manual_override/blocked or restricted projections as invalid/unknown. Saved/cache evidence may explain protection after a failed read but cannot be relabeled as a successful current response.
legacy_model_quota.time_units: Protection cooldownUntil/model_cooldowns are Unix seconds; require finite nonnegative values and valid Date range without magnitude-based millisecond guessing. resetTimeRaw is a separate timestamp-string field. Countdown zero does not mutate server restrictions.
legacy_model_quota.write_evidence: AG manual results can expose phase/phases, started, status_code/upstream_status, response_source, models, observation, model_access_state/families/model_access_update, and state_update. Failed/skipped/pending/missing write evidence is not applied; never equate upstream success with all state updates applied.

regression_evidence.observed: Binding 200/201/409 × storage true/false separates success from state_update; AG unsupported; upstream failure/write exception; mode-specific capability.
Release preserves timed cooldown; only a new actual business 429 reblocks after release, not probe 429/503.
Valid other group supported; unauthorized release unchanged; authorized release still preserves timed cooldown.
Unknown/rolling quota and invalid/partial evidence warnings; other valid group release; exact action body and pending-refresh label preserve other groups.

implementation_gates: No implementation claimed. Inspect final stable accepted direct frontend dependencies before creating/finalizing a new request; do not read in-flight writers.
Separate release adapter tests from Page wiring if either consumes an API file being edited. Shared read-only Core/session dependencies are not file-write conflicts.
Use real current session + Scope3 + validation snapshot identity fences; same-Scope validation loss/reverification must not revive old callbacks or late responses.
Only explicit user mutations; no automatic release, Preview or test; no retries that duplicate mutations. Keep full credential material outside this public state.

Synthetic tests must cover actual method/body/mode/encoding, unknown/malformed evidence, preserved cooldown and other groups, partial state_update, and owner/abort late results. Runtime acceptance remains pending.
